note: The crossing needed a frame with elemental law unwritten, and this is the world whose budget leaves it unwritten: three seats on physical, life and qi, with no seasonal clock. A fire body crossing an ash body buys its rate from the gap rather than from a written law, so the race is native to the frame that has the gap and cannot hold anywhere elemental law is seated.

The shortfall the crossing pays for is written here rather than restated: elemental law is unwritten at this tier, so the fire half has nothing licensed to spend into and the scarring rate follows from that absence rather than from any discipline.
